C1209.title: Nicholas Truglia Sentenced to 12 Years for $22 Million Cryptocurrency Theft via SIM Swap Attack
C1209.summary: Nicholas Truglia conducted SIM swap attacks to hijack victims' phone numbers, bypass SMS-based two-factor authentication, and illegally access and steal approximately $22 million in cryptocurrency. In January 2026, he was sentenced to 12 years in prison, highlighting the significant threat SIM swap attacks pose to digital assets.
